description: Manage the doing task stack. Add a task, complete one, list tasks, or view the full stack with UI.

command.description: add: push a task | done: complete a task | list: view the stack (default: inferred from other args)

index.description: 0-based index to complete (defaults to last, only for 'done')

task.description: Task description — if provided without 'command', defaults to 'add'

name: doing
